scope: Ordinary WLD file read, open/metadata and PNG thumbnail; no UI or TCW
sourceManifestProvenance: Final source manifest identity supplied by the coordinating build task; measured Native and WASM identities verified before and after each process.

methodology.execution: One backend process at a time, alternating backend order across rounds.
methodology.fresh: First ordinary WLD load in a fresh runtime process. OS page cache is uncontrolled and never flushed.
methodology.warm: Three sequential close/read/open/thumbnail cycles after the first load in each process; runtime instance reused, input reread each cycle.
methodology.scope: Read-only local file read, runtime initialization, ordinary WLD open including header/format/chests/bestiary metadata, PNG creation and host copy; explicit close and final validated reopen.
methodology.totals: Totals sum individually timed phases; exclude input SHA validation, PNG validation, memory snapshots and report bookkeeping. readInitOpenThumbnail adds lazy runtime/library setup but excludes interpreter/process startup.
methodology.native: Direct ctypes host uses production pointer-safe C facade. Includes input copy and metadata JSON decode; excludes Dart FFI/isolate and Flutter. Native app request 1024x1024 is retained.
methodology.wasm: Actual production Node-loaded document bridge and release WASM. Includes JS bridge input copy, chunked open yields and metadata parse. Web app request max_w=960 is retained.
methodology.memory: Process RSS snapshots and whole-process high-water RSS include host, runtime, validation and all preceding cycles; they are not engine live bytes or operation-specific peaks. WASM capacity is not live allocation.
methodology.comparison: Preview dimensions and host stacks differ, so no strict cross-platform ranking or historical speedup claim. Not Flutter chooser-to-frame latency, raster rendering, browser worker startup, TCW compilation or circuit execution.
methodology.privacy: No source path, name, hash, world metadata contents, WLD bytes, or PNG contents are serialized.
methodology.wasmImplicitOpeningPreview: The production Web incremental open path also generates a 384px-wide opening preview internally before this harness requests the explicit 960px-wide PNG. Native synchronous buffer open does not perform that implicit preview.
methodology.sampleDependence: Three independent runtime processes per backend; the nine warm samples are grouped three per process and are not nine independent processes.
methodology.historicalComparison: Historical Native numbers included Dart/isolate overhead and a mixed preloaded-input workload. This direct ctypes harness cannot support a precise historical speedup percentage. No strict cross-platform ranking is claimed.
